headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger's test indicates no significant funnel plot asymmetry (p=0.1845). The distribution of studies appears symmetric, suggesting a lower risk of publication bias.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 5 studies yielded an effect size of 1.33 (95% CI: 0.43–4.11), indicating no statistically significant association between copper and uterine cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential positive relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 93.71%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
